The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 67d6dd8619de6c6f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 15-16. statement: Let M be a compact smooth manifold of positive finite dimension, let ν be a smooth positive probability volume in the density sense of Section 1, and let S : M → M be a smooth diffeomorphism preserving ν. Fix a Riemannian distance dM and η > 0. There exist positive numbers Bk with P k B16 k < ∞ and a constant C such that the following holds for all sufficiently large k, with n = 2k. There is a finite measurable partition Dk of M with #Dk ≤ exp(CBkn). Define the proba- bility measure ρk = X Q∈Dk ν(Q)>0 (ν|Q) ⊗ (ν|Q) ν(Q) . (4.1) Thus one first samples a cell with its ν-weight and then samples two independent points in that cell. There are a measurable set Gk ⊂ M × M, with ρk(Gk) ≥ 1 − η, and a measurable map zk : Gk → M such that (zk)∗(ρk|Gk ) ≤ 2ν (4.2) and sup (x,y)∈Gk  max 0≤t≤n dM (St zk(x, y), St x) + max −n≤t≤0 dM (St zk(x, y), St y)  −→ 0. (4.3) 15 The measure on the left of (4.2) is not normalized after restriction to Gk. The same conclusions hold if M has a smooth boundary.
